about_the_game:
Gameplay:

Planet Chyton is a metroidvania with unique shooting combat where some enemies may involve the player needing to stomp or shoot at it to reveal its weak spots and platforming with the use of the ability to create your own platform with a projectile fired from your gun. Throughout Cubit's adventure, as you explore, you will find new abilities and fight monstrous bosses.

Features:

-New Unique platforming and shooting abilities, along with the classic double jump and dash. -Lots of different enemy variety that may require different ways to beat them to make each engagement feel unique and interesting

-Boss fights incorporate the use of different abilities

-Dark but colorful environment to explore

-Dual Save system-After your death, you can select from 2 save point types: One heals you for only half health but its more numerous, one that heals you to full health but its more fewer and far between.

-Difficulty Selection: You can choose from 3 different difficulty along with an unlockable Insane difficulty.

-Collect in game currency to buy upgrades to improve the player's ablities.

-Collect Alien Language Translators to talk to alien NPC's to acquire hints, items, access to a new item shop, open new paths, or aid you in certain ways.

name: Planet Chyton

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1255U 1.70 GHz
  • Memory: 300 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) Xe Graphics

short_description: Planet Chyton is a metroidvania where you are a small robot that can create platforms with its gun. Shoot and stomp creatures as you jump your way to aid dying astronaut explorers with their survival in this world.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
